questions.question:
Three Statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statement I :** All bicycles are wheels.

**Statement II :** Some wheels are rubber.

**Statement III : **No rubber is plastic.

**Conclusion I :** Some wheels are bicycles.

**Conclusion II : **Some wheels are plastics.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cc0b305e346b06cf464c46c3b9b22a5a4fc9915518b671b80546a59e911bab15.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some wheels are bicycles → **F**ollow (As all bicycles are wheels. As whole bicycles comes in wheels which has some part common with rubber, therefore it is true.)

II. Some wheels are plastics → Does not follow (As some wheels are rubber and no rubber is plastic. So it is possible but not definite)

∴ Here, Only conclusion I follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1"

questions.question:
Which of the following groups of letters when sequentially placed from left to right will complete the given series?

ghijkgh_jkghijkg_ijkghijk_hi_
questions.solution:
Given series: ghijkgh_jkghijkg_ijkghijk_hi_

Option 1) ihgj → ghijkgh__**i**__jkghijkg__**h**__ijkghijk__**g**__hi__**j**__ → (It follows the pattern of: ghijk - ghijk - ghijk - ghijk - ghijk)

Option 2) kijg → ghijkgh__k__jkghijkg__i__ijkghijk__j__hi__g__ → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 3) ghgh → ghijkgh__g__jkghijkg__h__ijkghijk__g__hi**__h__** → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 4) ihjk → ghijkgh__i__jkghijkg__h__ijkghijk__j__hi__k__ → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
